ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the financial document:  Aarvi Encon Limited reported a strong financial performance for FY 2025-26, with consolidated revenue growing 27% to ₹649.85 crore and Profit After Tax increasing significantly by ~75% to ₹17.62 crore, driven largely by robust international business expansion (73% revenue growth, 179% PAT growth) and diversification into higher-margin O&M services. While the statutory audit was clean and a 20% dividend was recommended, the Secretarial Audit Report contained an observation (addressed by management), and the very low 1% marginal profit reported for Indonesia operations warrants monitoring for potential material impact on overall profitability.
